quote: Whenever any person is riding a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a sidewalk, such person shall yield the right-of-way to any pedestrian and shall give audible signal before overtaking and passing such pedestrian.

activation.condition: Covered bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter ridden on sidewalk with a pedestrian.

obligation.description: Yield pedestrian right-of-way and give an audible signal before overtaking and passing.

timing.description: Signal precedes overtaking and passing; yield persists for the pedestrian encounter.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter
judgment_calls_needed.note: Device class must be established by original asset and independent source review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: yield the right-of-way to any pedestrian
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original actor footprint trajectories and scene context support independent judgment; no numeric legal cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: audible signal before overtaking and passing
judgment_calls_needed.note: Pedestrian-location microphone PCM and frame map support temporal review; sound identity and audibility need independent review.

parameter_refs.name: signal_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: signal at frame 80 or none; actual source order reviewed

parameter_refs.name: pause_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: requested rider pause window or no pause; actual pedestrian priority reviewed
